description: External alterations to relocate an entrance door including additional front and side windows and altering existing windows to the office.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the finishing of the external alterations to the building shall be as shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 01(A), 02(A), 03(A) and 04(A), Design and Access Statement and Door and Window Specification documents [received 21/07/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
